newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Trading quiet after hours.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Trading quiet after hours.

text.p: Traders said activity after hours was quiet on Tuesday.
"There is not a lot happening here right now," a trader said.
The New York Stock Exchange said its session one volume was 33,900 shares compared with 52,600 shares on Monday. Session two volume was 462,900 shares compared with 1,310,635 shares on Monday.
The American Stock Exchange said it had no after-hours activity.
